title: Ancient Forest
palette: deep evergreen, rich jade, moss-gold, turquoise atmospheric shadow
scene: A dreamlike ancient forest at first-person eye level. A generous walkable earthen path begins at bottom center and winds among colossal old trees with spreading roots, under a high vaulted leafy canopy toward a small golden glade. Moss-covered boulders and delicate fern colonies frame the sides. Overlapping depths of luminous green and cool turquoise woodland, scattered shafts of honey sunlight, extraordinary scale without blocking the route.
wall: flat ancient dark warm bark with broad vertical furrows and muted moss
floor: flat woodland earth with fine leaf litter and small root fibers, no large objects
secondary: flat soft jade moss over quiet dark stone with tiny cracks
detail: flat dense overlapping small fern and ivy leaf surface in muted varied greens
concept_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production biome concept for Recurant, a first-person fantasy exploration game. Create a gorgeous refined painterly pixel-art landscape in the spirit of richly colored early-1990s Lands of Lore environments, with deliberate pixel clusters, elegant atmospheric color and warm/cool relationships; not muddy, not cheap flat vector art, not photorealism. Landscape 4:3 composition, intended native 320x240 pixels with readable clusters. Full image, no frame, UI, text, labels, signatures, logos, people, creatures, weapons or first-person hands. Clearly navigable floor, eye-height first-person view, no aerial or isometric camera. Original composition, do not copy any existing game or card image. atlas_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: actual diffuse material texture atlas for a low-resolution first-person fantasy game, NOT concept art. Produce exactly ONE square image divided precisely into a 2 by 2 grid of FOUR equal borderless square texture swatches, filling every pixel. TOP LEFT: flat ancient dark warm bark with broad vertical furrows and muted moss. TOP RIGHT: flat woodland earth with fine leaf litter and small root fibers, no large objects. BOTTOM LEFT: flat soft jade moss over quiet dark stone with tiny cracks. BOTTOM RIGHT: flat dense overlapping small fern and ivy leaf surface in muted varied greens. Each is a distinct close-up FLAT ORTHOGRAPHIC SURFACE, not an object, scene, panel, cube, tile slab or perspective floor. Material surfaces alone; absolutely no horizon, scenery, shadow-casting objects, bevelled borders, text, labels, frame, gutters, gaps or margin. Neutral even ambient illumination across each square; no vignette, bright center or directional gradient. Quiet low-frequency painterly pixel texture and intentional hand-painted clusters, refined rich early-1990s fantasy color, intended to downsample crisply to 256x256 per swatch. Palette: deep evergreen, rich jade, moss-gold, turquoise atmospheric shadow. All four swatches should tile seamlessly on their own along both axes: match corresponding opposite edges, avoid singular center motifs, keep detail small and distributed, continue organic patterns across boundaries. Each quadrant must remain entirely its own material, sharp boundary exactly at the 50% horizontal and vertical midpoint. Do not depict four scenic landscapes. Do not paint objects on a background. Original work.
